import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    w = int(input_data[0])
    m = int(input_data[1])
    sum_arr = [0] * 105
    pw = [0] * 105
    OK = False

    p = 1
    mx = 0
    for i in range(100):
        sum_arr[i + 1] = p + sum_arr[i]
        pw[i] = p
        p *= w
        if p > 1 << 40:
            mx = i
            break

    def process(cur, target, pos):
        nonlocal OK
        if OK:
            return
        if cur == target:
            OK = True
            return
        remaining = sum_arr[pos + 1]
        next_val = pw[pos]
        if cur - remaining > target:
            return
        elif cur + remaining < target:
            return
        else:
            if cur + sum_arr[pos] < target:
                process(cur + next_val, target, pos - 1)
            elif cur - sum_arr[pos] > target:
                process(cur - next_val, target, pos - 1)
            else:
                process(cur, target, pos - 1)

    process(0, m, mx)
    print("YES" if OK else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
